/bin/bash -c "rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | head -100; cat package.json; rg -n 'catalog|category|loading' app src pages components 2>/dev/null | head -180; rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs | rg '(link|prefetch|navigation|search-param|cache|route)' | head -90; cat AGENTS.md"

/bin/bash -c "cat app/page.tsx app/catalog/page.tsx lib/data.ts next.config.ts; sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/instant-navigation.md; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/prefetching.md; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/prefetch.md"

/bin/bash -c "rg -n '"'^##|''^###|''^With|''^Without|''^The |''^If |''^Note|''^> |'"\\b(prefetch|uncached|cached|loading|instant)\\b' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/optimizing-prefetching.md | head -145; sed -n '27,185p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/optimizing-prefetching.md; rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js | rg partial; sed -n '1,205p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/adopting-partial-prefetching.md"
